FFmpeg (embedded git describe), whisper.cpp, dav1d, aom, vmaf, opencv_contrib, bigsh0t, Shotcut are exact pins. (3) libjack64.dll (JACK2 1.9.17) and opengl32sw.dll (Mesa 19.2.7) come from Meltytech's binary mlt-prebuilt-mingw64-v7.txz (not downloaded: fetch was blocked by the environment's safety policy); the upstream release tarballs are listed, but the exact build recipe Meltytech used for these two binaries is unknown; SDL2.dll matches MSYS2 SDL2-2.32.10-1 by mtime/version and may also have been copied from that prebuilt. (4) Shotcut tag archive, OpenCV commit, gpmf-parser and AMF archives are GitHub codeload streams > 20 MB: size not measured (bytes=0).
